title: Claude Design is serious… 👀 #trendingshorts #ai #design #tech
description:
Last week Anthropic launched Claude Design, a new AI tool from its Anthropic Labs division that generates prototypes, slide decks, and marketing materials from text prompts.

Powered by the new Claude Opus 4.7 vision model, it reads a company's codebase to build a custom brand system that applies automatically to future projects.

Available in research preview to paid Claude subscribers, the tool exports to Canva, PowerPoint, or hands off to Claude Code for implementation.

Early users report significant efficiency gains, though limitations include high token consumption and intermittent bugs.

The launch follows Anthropic CPO Mike Krieger's resignation from Figma's board three days prior to the release 👀
